newsitem.title: UK: BOE GIVES UK MONEY MARKET 420 MLN STG FURTHER HELP.
newsitem.headline: BOE GIVES UK MONEY MARKET 420 MLN STG FURTHER HELP.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 420 million stg of assistance at established interest rates to help offset an estimated money market shortage of 1.7 billion stg.
The central bank's repo rate remain unchanged at 7.0 percent.
The bank bought 400 million stg of bills outright and 20 million in repos to August 26 and August 27.
In an early round of operations it bought 1.141 billion stg of bills -- 61 million outright and 1.080 billion in repos.
